deviations_from_card: Two commits instead of three: the rigdir module and __main__ publish landed together (test_rigdir's end-to-end case imports both), then depth_map. Tests landed in the same commits as the implementation because they import rigdir (ImportError before, not an assertion). tools/avatar/test_learned_depth.py was not edited (passes unchanged). Stale publish REMOVES the pair (not keep-and-report); a missing pair also removes an orphan depth.png and prints 'no depth map beside the rig: run ...'.
notes: Red before: rig side 10 tests behind 1 import error; avatar side 5 (3 assertion failures incl. portrait 50.2 vs 100 and '../escape.png' read without error, 2 errors: no dm.rigdir, no --check). ruff check on tools/avatar reports 6 pre-existing E741 (`l` variables, present at HEAD) and the avatar files were not ruff-formatted at HEAD; left as they were. learned.in.npy for an existing rig changes once (the model now sees the stage's frame), so learned-v1 re-pends once as the card's rollback note expects. Follow-up out of scope: the stage's checkDepthMeta (apps/stage/src/avatar/depth/geom.ts) still does not compare inputs.
